verdict.rationale: Neon has a first-party "Neon Read Replicas" docs page, so adding read replicas is a documented capability, and the MCP inspect_database tool reports replication state. The pack gives only the page title, though, with no detail on how replicas are created or behave. Nothing in the pack documents high-availability or failover behavior. Missing for 10: documented HA/failover semantics (e.g., failover time, durability guarantees), detail on read replica setup and lag, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
